A nested table flattened into a cell keeps its row boundaries as literal <br> when br_in_tables is enabled

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>"
    options = ConversionOptions(br_in_tables=True, compact_tables=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
